text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross got injured during training,
so I rushed over to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not exactly doing great,
but at least it was mild enough
that the infirmary could patch me up."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, training's looking out of the question, huh...
Frustrating as it is, I'll have to stay put for a while...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, while I'm resting,
everyone else is moving forward...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...I hear there are athletes in this world who tape themselves up and compete even with terrible injuries.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"My injury is lighter than that,
so wouldn't it be fine for me to run just a little bit?"
choice_data_list: ...All right. Be careful out there on the track.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't make such a scary face.
I was just sayin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's no good after all...
Well, I'll be good and sleep so I get better fast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a bitter remark, Tamamo Cross slowly headed back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna try it out.
I won't push myself too hard, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Ow ow ow ow. No good,
looks like the injury from earlier got worse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow-ow-ouch! Guh...!
I should've stayed quiet till it healed up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because Tamamo Cross pushed herself too hard, it took longer for her to fully recover.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna try it out.
I won't push myself too hard, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Oh...! Looks like just light running is totally fine!
The nurse in the infirmary really works miracles!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross trained within reasonable limits, being mindful of her injury.
